craft_notes: Sthāyin: impure path commissioned. Rows: limit then license. Read aloud: turn.

lines: Thus far straight Śiva makes; but the foul path
by the Highest's will-sway, for the waverers' bliss-seedlings.
l4.sanskrit_cite: iyati sākṣāt śivaḥ kartā aśuddhaṃ punar adhvānam anantāparanāmāghoreśaḥ sṛjati īśvarecchāvaśena prakṣubdhabhogalolikānām aṇūnāṃ bhogasiddhyartham
